title: Seetha's anguish about Rama and Lakshmana
introduction: Ravana summons some female demons including Trijata and instructs them to take Seetha in Pushpaka-plane to the battle-front and show Rama and Lakshmana alleged to have been killed by Indrajit. Accordingly, the female-demons take Seetha in Pushpaka-plane and show her Rama and Lakshmana lying unconscious on a bed of arrows in the battle-field. Imagining Rama and Lakshmana to have been dead, Seetha bursts into sobs.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 47th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् प्रतिप्रविष्टे लन्काम् तु कृत अर्थे रावण आत्मजे |
राघवम् परिवार्य आर्ता ररक्षुर् वानर ऋषभाः
verses.iast:
tasmin pratipraviṣṭe lankām tu kṛta arthe rāvaṇa ātmaje |
rāghavam parivārya ārtā rarakṣur vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: Indrajit, the son of Ravana having returned to Lanka, his purpose accomplished, the leading monkeys surrounded Rama in order to watch over him.

verses.devanagari:
हनूमान् अन्गदो नीलह् सुषेणह् कुमुदो नलः |
गजो गव अक्षो गवयह् शरभो गन्ध मादनः
जाम्बवान् ऋषभह् सुन्दो रम्भह् शत बलिह् पृथुः |
व्यूढ अनीकाश् च यत्ताश् च द्रुमान् आदाय सर्वतः
वीक्षमाणा दिशह् सर्वास् तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वम् च वानराः |
तृणेष्व् अपि च चेष्टत्सु राक्षसा;इति मेनिरे
verses.iast:
hanūmān angado nīlah suṣeṇah kumudo nalaḥ |
gajo gava akṣo gavayah śarabho gandha mādanaḥ
jāmbavān ṛṣabhah sundo rambhah śata balih pṛthuḥ |
vyūḍha anīkāś ca yattāś ca drumān ādāya sarvataḥ
vīkṣamāṇā diśah sarvās tiryag ūrdhvam ca vānarāḥ |
tṛṇeṣv api ca ceṣṭatsu rākṣasā;iti menire
verses.translation: Hanuman, Angada, Nila, Sushena, Kumuda, Nala, Gaja, Gavaksha, Panasa, Sanuprastha and the mighty Jambavan with Sunda, Rambha, Shatabali and Prithu all these monkeys, armed with trees, reorganized their ranks, stood alert, surveyed the quarters of the sky up and down and on every side and, even if a grass stirred, they exclaimed, "It is a demon!"

verses.devanagari:
रावणश् च अपि सम्हृष्टो विसृज्य इन्द्रजितम् सुतम् |
आजुहाव ततह् सीता रक्षणी राक्षसीस् तदा
verses.iast:
rāvaṇaś ca api samhṛṣṭo visṛjya indrajitam sutam |
ājuhāva tatah sītā rakṣaṇī rākṣasīs tadā
verses.translation: Ravana, meanwhile, full of joy, dismissed his son Indrajit and thereafter summoned the female demons who guarded Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षस्यस् त्रिजटा च अपि शासनात् तम् उपस्थिताः |
ता उवाच ततो हृष्टो राक्षसी राक्षस ईश्वरः
verses.iast:
rākṣasyas trijaṭā ca api śāsanāt tam upasthitāḥ |
tā uvāca tato hṛṣṭo rākṣasī rākṣasa īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Following his orders, the female-demons along with Trijata appeared before him. Then, the rejoiced Ravana said to them as follows:

verses.devanagari:
हताव् इन्द्रजिता आख्यात वैदेह्या राम लक्ष्मणौ |
पुष्पकम् च समारोप्य दर्शयध्वम् हतौ रणे
verses.iast:
hatāv indrajitā ākhyāta vaidehyā rāma lakṣmaṇau |
puṣpakam ca samāropya darśayadhvam hatau raṇe
verses.translation: "Tell Seetha that Rama and Lakshmana have been killed by Indrajit. Take her in Pushpaka the aeroplane and show her Rama and Lakshman who were killed in battle."

verses.devanagari:
यद् आश्रयाद् अवष्टब्धो न इयम् माम् उपतिष्ठति |
सो अस्या भर्ता सह भ्रात्रा निरस्तो रण मूर्धनि
verses.iast:
yad āśrayād avaṣṭabdho na iyam mām upatiṣṭhati |
so asyā bhartā saha bhrātrā nirasto raṇa mūrdhani
verses.translation: "Her husband, the one depending on whom rendered her so proud that she refused to be united with me, lies there killed with his brother in the battle-front."

verses.devanagari:
निर्विशन्का निरुद्विग्ना निरपेक्षा च मैथिली |
माम् उपस्थास्यते सीता सर्व आभरण भूषिता
verses.iast:
nirviśankā nirudvignā nirapekṣā ca maithilī |
mām upasthāsyate sītā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā
verses.translation: "From now on, free from anxiety, grief and expectation of reunion, Seetha the princess of Mithila kingdom, adorned in all her jewels, will submit herself to me."

glosses.meaning: adorned herself with all kinds of ornaments
and without any hope of reunion.

verses.devanagari:
अद्य काल वशम् प्राप्तम् रणे रामम् सलक्ष्मणम् |
अवेक्ष्य विनिवृत्त आशा न अन्याम् गतिम् अपश्यती
अनपेक्षा विशालाक्षी मामुपस्थस्यते स्वयम् |
verses.iast:
adya kāla vaśam prāptam raṇe rāmam salakṣmaṇam |
avekṣya vinivṛtta āśā na anyām gatim apaśyatī
anapekṣā viśālākṣī māmupasthasyate svayam |
verses.translation: "Beholding Rama and Lakshmana fallen under the sway of death on the battle-field today, finding no other haven and hoping for nothing else, the large-eyed Seetha will voluntarily seek refuge with me!"

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
राक्षस्यस् तास् तथा इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रजग्मुर् यत्र पुष्पकम् |
verses.iast:
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
rākṣasyas tās tathā ity uktvā prajagmur yatra puṣpakam |
verses.translation: Hearing these words of the cruel Ravana, they all replied, "Be it so" and went to where the Pushpaka chariot was.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पुष्पकम् आदय राक्षस्यो रावण आज्नया
अशोक वनिकास्थाम् ताम् मैथिलीम् समुपानयन् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ puṣpakam ādaya rākṣasyo rāvaṇa ājnayā
aśoka vanikāsthām tām maithilīm samupānayan |
verses.translation: Thereafter, the female-demons brought the aerial car, Pushpaka as per the instructions of Ravana and carried it nearer to Seetha who was staying in Ashoka-grove.

glosses.meaning: as per the instructions of Ravana
who was staying in Ashoka grove.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् आदाय तु राक्षस्यो भर्तृ शोक परायणाम्
सीताम् आरोपयाम् आसुर् विमानम् पुष्पकम् तदा |
verses.iast:
tām ādāya tu rākṣasyo bhartṛ śoka parāyaṇām
sītām āropayām āsur vimānam puṣpakam tadā |
verses.translation: The female-demons brought Seetha who was afflicted with grief for her husband and made her to ascend Pushpaka-plane.

glosses.meaning: who was afflicted with grief for her husband

verses.devanagari:
ततः पुष्पकम् आरोप्य सीताम् त्रिजटया सह
जग्मुर्दर्शयितुं तस्यै राक्षस्यो रामलक्ष्मणौ |
verses.iast:
tataḥ puṣpakam āropya sītām trijaṭayā saha
jagmurdarśayituṃ tasyai rākṣasyo rāmalakṣmaṇau |
verses.translation: The female-demons along with Trijata made Seetha to ascend Pushpaka-plane and proceeded to show her Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
रावणो अकारयल् लन्काम् पताका ध्वज मालिनीम्
प्राघोषयत हृष्टश् च लन्कायाम् राक्षस ईश्वरः |
राघवो लक्ष्मणश् चैव हताव् इन्द्रजिता रणे
verses.iast:
rāvaṇo akārayal lankām patākā dhvaja mālinīm
prāghoṣayata hṛṣṭaś ca lankāyām rākṣasa īśvaraḥ |
rāghavo lakṣmaṇaś caiva hatāv indrajitā raṇe
verses.translation: Ravana the king of demons, thrilled with rapture, caused Lanka to be garlanded with flags and banners and arranged a proclamation to be made in Lanka announcing that Rama and Lakshmana had been slain by Indrajit in battle.

verses.devanagari:
विमानेन अपि सीता तु गत्वा त्रिजटया सह |
ददर्श वानराणाम् तु सर्वम् सिन्यम् निपातितम्
verses.iast:
vimānena api sītā tu gatvā trijaṭayā saha |
dadarśa vānarāṇām tu sarvam sinyam nipātitam
verses.translation: Seetha along with Trijata, transported by that plane, saw all the monkey-troops who had been slain.

verses.devanagari:
प्रहृष्ट मनसश् च अपि ददर्श पिशित अशनान् |
वानरांश् च अपि दुह्ख आर्तान् राम लक्ष्मण पार्श्वतः
verses.iast:
prahṛṣṭa manasaś ca api dadarśa piśita aśanān |
vānarāṃś ca api duhkha ārtān rāma lakṣmaṇa pārśvataḥ
verses.translation: Seetha saw the demons who were delighted at heart and monkeys disturbed with grief, standing round Rama and Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: who were disturbed with immense grief
by the side of Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सीता ददर्श उभौ शयानौ शत तल्पयोः |
लक्ष्मणम् चैव रामम् च विसम्ज्नौ शर पीडितौ
विध्वस्त कवचौ वीरौ विप्रविद्ध शर आसनौ |
सायकैश् चिन्न सर्व अन्गौ शर स्तम्भमयौ क्षितौ
verses.iast:
tataḥ sītā dadarśa ubhau śayānau śata talpayoḥ |
lakṣmaṇam caiva rāmam ca visamjnau śara pīḍitau
vidhvasta kavacau vīrau vipraviddha śara āsanau |
sāyakaiś cinna sarva angau śara stambhamayau kṣitau
verses.translation: Then, Seetha beheld those two warriors Rama and Lakshmana lying unconscious on the ground on a bed of arrows, their limbs pierced with arrows, riddled with weapons, their armour shattered, their bows cast aside at a distance and their entire body transfixed by darts.

glosses.meaning: their bows thrown at a distance

verses.devanagari:
तौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ तत्र प्रवीरौ पुरुष ऋषभौ |
शयानौ पुण्डरीकाक्षौ कुमाराविव पावकी
शरतल्पगतौ वीरौ तथाभूतौ नरर्षभौ |
दुह्ख आर्ता सुभृशम् सीता करुणम् विललाप ह
verses.iast:
tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau tatra pravīrau puruṣa ṛṣabhau |
śayānau puṇḍarīkākṣau kumārāviva pāvakī
śaratalpagatau vīrau tathābhūtau nararṣabhau |
duhkha ārtā subhṛśam sītā karuṇam vilalāpa ha
verses.translation: On seeing those two brothers, who were filled with valour, having lotus-eyes, the excellent of men, lying streteched on a bed of arrows there in that wretched plight like the two sons of the fire-god (Shkha and Vishakha) lying on a bed of reeds, Seetha wailed piteously, stricken as she was with a great agony.

glosses.meaning: lying stretched on a bed of arrows
of the fire-god (shakha and Vishakha) (lying on a bed of reeds)

verses.devanagari:
भर्तारमनवद्याङ्गी लक्ष्मणम् चासितेक्षणा |
प्रेक्ष्य पांसुषु चेष्टन्तौ रुरोद जनकात्मजा
verses.iast:
bhartāramanavadyāṇ^gī lakṣmaṇam cāsitekṣaṇā |
prekṣya pāṃsuṣu ceṣṭantau ruroda janakātmajā
verses.translation: The dark-eyed Seetha the daughter of Janaka with her faultless limbs, beholding her lord and Lakshmana lying in the dust, burst into sobs.

verses.devanagari:
सा बाष्प शोक अभिहता समीक्ष्य |
तौ भ्रातरौ देव सम प्रभावौ |
वितर्कयन्ती निधनम् तयोह् सा |
दुह्ख अन्विता वाक्यम् इदम् जगाद
verses.iast:
sā bāṣpa śoka abhihatā samīkṣya |
tau bhrātarau deva sama prabhāvau |
vitarkayantī nidhanam tayoh sā |
duhkha anvitā vākyam idam jagāda
verses.translation: Witnessing those brothers, the prominent sons of god, Seetha afflicted with tearful sorrow, believing their death, spoke with grief the following words.
